sam: quick triage from onboarding orion-12b-int4-longpack. long-prefill stress with repeated legal headers shows a small but reproducible KV-index drift after ~62k tokens. minimal repro + logs below.

izzy: which pack/rope mode?

sam: pack=longpack-v2, ROPE_MODE=fast. repro (single-line):
```
./long_eval --model orion-12b-int4 --file tests/long/legal_headers_repeat.txt --max-tokens 80000 --kv-verbose --seed=2026
```

arun: paste the tiny log fragment pls

sam: log tail:
```
[2026-09-02T14:08:12Z] kv: shard=0 write_idx=62298 expected_idx=62299 actual_idx=62296
[2026-09-02T14:08:12Z] rope: phase_calc computed=31149 stored=31147
[2026-09-02T14:08:12Z] integrity: ghost_token_detected token_id=14421 pos=62012
```

perf-bot: canary metrics uploaded -> token-integrity 0.38% p50 3.3ms p95 9.0ms (baseline 0.01%)

izzy: interesting. drift seems to be -3 at the index level and -2 at phase. maybe a packing stride miscount when crossing non-power-of-two boundary. can you try ROPE_MODE=legacy and PACK_ORDER=contig to A/B?

sam: quick A/B results: ROPE_MODE=legacy removes phase delta consistently but we still see occasional write_idx jumps; PACK_ORDER=contig drops index drift to near-zero in short runs. tradeoff: ppl slightly worse. pushed traces + seed-list to s3://redwood-evals/orion12b/int4/longpack/2099988776/trace.tar.gz

arun: thanks. hypothesis: longpack-v2 changed lane interleave and a recent kernel opt used floor-div with signed 16-bit which overflows at large offsets. I'll bisect the packer commit range and add an assert in the index increment routine to catch nonmonotonic writes. assigning to @arun to run kernel bisect.

sam: short-term mitigation: add a guardrail test in tester/longprefill/test_monotonic_kv.py that primes >100k tokens and validates monotonic write_idx and phase progression after each prepend. would catch this earlier. I'll open the PR.

deploy-bot: canary deploy triggered: orion-12b-int4-longpack -> staging-pool-2 at 2026-09-02T14:10:00Z

izzy: also worth trying KV_SYNC_MODE=sync for a quick gold-run to see if async reclamation/race contributes. if sync removes failures we know it's a race.

sam: KV_SYNC_MODE=sync dropped failure rate from 0.38% -> 0.02% but latency up ~15%. adding that datapoint to the artifact upload.

arun: plan: 1) bisect packer kernel, 2) land guardrail test in tester, 3) consider short-term pin to PACK_ORDER=contig for longpack-v2 images until root cause fixed. will post commit ids here when found.

sam: thanks all 44d will keep this thread as the single record for seeds, quick results, and the PR link when ready.
